entry.title: pgjdbc GSS connections can accept replayed replies and lose confidentiality
entry.summary: On connections that start GSS encryption, network replay can make an earlier reply accepted for a current query. Separately, an integrity-only packet from a party holding the session key can cause subsequent client SQL and parameters to be signed without encryption. entry.title: pgjdbc metadata queries can execute objects supplied by another database role
entry.summary: Unqualified catalog operators, functions and type names can resolve to another database role’s objects and run in the application session. Exploitation requires relevant database object-creation or temporary-object privileges and affected metadata/type operations. entry.title: pgjdbc simple-query parameter quoting can permit SQL injection
entry.summary: When non-default simple query mode is used with standard_conforming_strings disabled or changed, a string parameter can be interpreted as SQL under the application’s database role.
